title: CloudWatch observability in one screen
rememberThis: Metrics answer 'what' — Logs answer 'why'. Alarm on user-visible symptoms (queue age, error rate), not every metric.
High-cardinality dimensions (userId per metric) explode cost — aggregate or sample.
Logs Insights: start with filter on error patterns, then stats count by field.
X-Ray trace ID in structured logs links metrics spike to specific failed request.
Lambda+SQS debug order: queue depth → Lambda Errors/Throttles → DLQ count → Logs Insights → X-Ray trace.
bullets: Embedded Metric Format (EMF) in Lambda logs auto-creates custom metrics without PutMetricData API calls.
Composite alarms reduce pager noise: fire only when queue age AND error rate both breach.
Log retention defaults to never expire — set per-group retention to control cost.
X-Ray sampling: 1 req/sec + 5% thereafter default; tune for high-traffic services.
Metric math: m1/m2*100 for error percentage across two metrics in one alarm.
